text.tspan: FIT-CRITICAL: 16 switch openings 14.00 +0.05/-0 AFTER
FIT: split face; lens recess 31.4 square R2.1 x 1.15 deep;
web 0.80 with 24.8 window.
Encoder pockets 14.8 square: depth from the split face 5.25
+0.10/-0.00 (ceiling never below Z 0.25).
G1, G2 post end faces BARE after anodise (laser-clear or
face-mill): case ground (D6).
G1, G2: BOTTOMING tap, chamfer 0.5 or less; full thread 3.00
is a minimum (D6, to confirm).

svg.text: Racking points on inner cavity faces only.

text.tspan: 6061-T6. Bead blast, then Type II sulphuric anodise, black,
appearance Strict (enclosure 1).
General tolerance ISO 2768-m (a proposal, not a tested
requirement). Break edges 0.05 unless drawn.
Internal corners: R = depth/10 + 0.5 or more; the 2.0 mm
tool is needed where R 1.0 or R 1.05 is drawn.
Threads below M5 are plugged during anodise and stay bare
(JLCCNC).
Not ordered. Nothing has been milled. Check every fit on the
first article before the batch.
